title: Test Covers KaTeX-Classed Overlay Probe
description: The frontend module shall have a test asserting that a katex-classed span with position:fixed style is sanitized.
rationale: A KaTeX-classed element bypasses the unconditional style-strip path and enters the property-scoped allowlist. Without a dedicated probe confirming that position:fixed fails the allowlist on katex-classed elements, a regression in the allowlist logic could re-open the phishing-overlay attack surface undetected.
